newsitem.title: FRANCE: France says will not hurt Eramet value.
newsitem.headline: France says will not hurt Eramet value.

text.p: The French Ministry of Industry said in a statement that it while it supported a plan for the construction of a new nickel plant in New Caledonia and planned to expropriate the Koniambo mining licence, it would not hurt Eramet's asset value.

"This procedure could lead to the withdrawal of concessions on the mine held by Le Nickel SLN (Groupe Eramet). The government will see to it that the patrimonial interests of Eramet will not be hurt," the ministry said.

In the statement, the Industry Ministry said that the new nickel plant needed to be supplied with ore and in order to obtain an optimal management of the mining assets it planned to rescind the operation concession of Konambio.

The Ministry said that the mining decree of November 13, 1954 included the possibility of a withdrawal of the mining licence if the concession holder had not done any exploitation for more than 10 years.
"The last exploitaton of Konambio goes back to 1975," the ministry said.
